versions.content: If a data element has been received invalidated in case of Intra- ECU communication and the attribute handleInvalid is set to replace  RTE shall perform the "invalid value substitution" with the initValue . Then the reception will be handled as if a valid value would have been received (activation of runnable entities using the DataReceivedEvent ).
